paragraphs: An outbreak of Salmonella Telelkebir linked to raw oysters remains ongoing, with 28 cases across 13 states and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 30 [1]. Consumers should consult CDC guidance or their local health department regarding raw oyster consumption [1].

Vitality Works Inc. is recalling one lot of 365 Whole Foods Market Standardized + Full Spectrum Blend Ashwagandha Capsules (lot number 2025-26227) due to potential Salmonella contamination [4]. HAIFA SMOKED FISH is recalling approximately 560 pounds of Cold Smoked Sprats due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum, a bacterium that can cause life-threatening illness; consumers should not use the product even if it looks or smells normal [7]. SLR Food Distribution Inc. is recalling Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because of elevated lead levels [5]. Taylor Farms is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad Kit due to undeclared soy and tree nuts (almonds) [6].
The FDA issued a warning about Once Upon A Farm Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars, covering all flavors, quantities, lots, and dates, following reports of infants choking [17].
